svg.aria-label: An open-plan office floor plate, cut at the ceiling line, with a lift-and-stair core, six structural columns and 1,000 desks in a 40 by 25 grid. Two desks are natives: each has its own machine and a tall red token stack rising from it, towering over the floor, because those two burn more tokens than the other 998 people combined. Three months later the red has spread to fourteen neighbouring desks around the two, each with a shorter stack.
